headlines.title: CNN’s Christiane Amanpour to depart network after 43 years
headlines.description: “I’m very sorry to see her go, but I’ve come to accept that this is the right time for her, both personally and professionally,” CNN chief executive Mark Thompson said.

headlines.title: Elon Musk and Anthropic make promises to give the public a piece of the AI pie
headlines.description: Elon Musk and officials at AI giant Anthropic are pledging to give coveted shares in their companies to the general public as concerns about AI’s economic and societal impact continue to pile up.

headlines.title: Cracks are beginning to show in the stock market as doubts about AI investments grow
headlines.description: Consumers already face a host of stressors. If AI spending and tech stocks show signs of sustained decline, U.S. economic growth could be at risk.

headlines.title: AI and the cognitive confidence trap
headlines.description: Can AI make us feel smarter than we really are? Princeton psychologist Dr. Tania Lombrozo explains the Dunning-Kruger effect, the illusion of understanding, and how AI shapes our perception of expertise, explaining why confidence doesn't always mean we truly understand what we know.

headlines.title: Tesla unveils new flying car model
headlines.description: It may be a giant leap forward in making flying cars a reality, or a fantastic publicity stunt. Elon Musk is showing off a new Tesla Roadster that can fly. NBC News’ Brian Cheung reports.

headlines.title: Tesla unveils its next generation 'flying' Roadster
headlines.description: Tesla has unveiled a new generation of the Roadster that Elon Musk believes will be able to fly. The sports car has new features such as air jets that allow the car to perform brief mid-air maneuvers. Musk says the car is set to start production in 2028. NBC News' Brian Cheung has more on the advancing technology.

headlines.title: Tesla shows its long-delayed Roadster that can briefly fly through the air
headlines.description: Tesla showed off a new version of its long-delayed Roadster, demonstrating a prototype sports car that can briefly fly through the air using high-pressure gas thrusters developed with SpaceX.

headlines.title: German police seize robot that allegedly groped teenage girl on livestream
headlines.description: Police in Germany are investigating after a livestream captured a robot allegedly groping a 16-year-old girl. The robot's teenage owner and his companion are now being investigated on suspicion of sexual harassment. NBC News' Matt Bradley reports.

headlines.title: German police seize robot after it allegedly groped a teenage girl
headlines.description: German police seized a robot after it allegedly made thrusting movements and grabbed the buttocks of a 16-year-old girl. Authorities are investigating whether two young men, who streamed and commentated the incident, were at the controls. NBC News' Misty Marris discusses how police are gathering evidence to potentially hold the men criminally responsible.

headlines.title: OpenAI employee accused of bugging an executive conference room
headlines.description: OpenAI said the FBI has arrested Abdulrahman Alfozan, one of its employees, after being accused of bugging an executive conference room at the company's San Francisco office. Alfozan is a Saudi national and began working with OpenAI in 2025. NBC News' Liz Kreutz has more on the arrest and charges.

headlines.title: Massive cyberattack targets refrigerators in supermarkets across France
headlines.description: Mountains of fresh and frozen food had to be thrown out after hackers cranked the temperature of refrigerators in supermarkets across France. Experts say it could signal a new cybersecurity threat that could impact Americans as well. NBC’s Tom Costello reports.

headlines.title: 'I am not an AI-friendly actor': Nicolas Cage says he refused to sign Amazon AI waiver
headlines.description: Oscar-winning actor Nicolas Cage spoke out against artificial intelligence and Amazon, the studio behind his show "Spider-Noir," saying he refused to sign an AI waiver. It comes as the debate over artificial intelligence divides Hollywood. NBC News' Chloe Melas reports.
